'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war]]
***Several people are injured in alleged [[Israel]]i airstrikes on [[Damascus]], [[Syria]], the first since the [[Israeli bombing of the Iranian embassy in Damascus|attack on the Iranian consulate]] in April. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-799678 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Alliance of Sahel States]]
**[[Nigerien crisis (2023–present)|Nigerien crisis]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian military]] personnel enter the [[United States]]–operated Niger Air Base 101 near [[Diori Hamani International Airport]] in [[Niger]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/russian-troops-enter-base-housing-us-military-niger-us-official-says-2024-05-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] take control of the village of [[Berdychi]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/05/02/russia-claims-control-of-berdychi-in-eastern-ukraine (Al-Arabiya News)]
**At least nine people, including eight children, are injured in a [[Russia]]n [[Guided bomb|guided]] [[airstrike]] in [[Derhachi]], [[Kharkiv Oblast]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/six-children-wounded-in-russian-strike-on-kharkiv-region-governor-74b3fd08 (AFP via ''Barron's'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-guided-bombs-injure-eight-children-ukraines-kharkiv-region-2024-05-02/ (Reuters)]
*A [[Palestinian National Security Forces]] patrol kills a [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]] gunman in [[Tulkarm]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/palestinian-security-force-kills-islamic-jihad-gunman-rare-internal-clash-2024-05-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the Israel–Hamas war]], [[Israel–Turkey relations]]
**[[Turkey]] suspends all trade with [[Israel]] in response to their conduct in the [[Israel–Hamas war|war in Gaza]] and demands that [[humanitarian aid]] be allowed to enter the [[Gaza Strip]] uninterrupted, after previously suspending some exports to Israel in April. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/may/02/turkey-reportedly-halts-all-trade-israel-war-gaza (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-says-turkeys-erdogan-is-breaking-agreements-by-blocking-ports-trade-2024-05-02/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents''' 
*[[2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods]]
**The death toll from ongoing flooding in [[Rio Grande do Sul]], [[Brazil]], increases to 13. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/05/02/world/americas/brazil-rain-floods.html (''The New York Times'')]
*Eleven people are killed and nine others injured after lightning strikes across five districts in [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/accidents-fires/news/lightning-strikes-claim-11-lives-5-districts-3600441 (The Daily Star)]
*Five people are killed and 21 injured after a vehicle veered off the road and overturned in [[Samangan Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20240502/79a78d4dcddd44e4b54cd500285caba2/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International recognition of the State of Palestine]]
**[[Trinidad and Tobago]] formally recognizes [[State of Palestine|Palestine]] as an independent nation. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/trinidad-and-tobago-formally-recognise-state-palestine?nid=360211&topic=Israel%2527s%2520war%2520on%2520Gaza&fid=512636 (''Middle East Eye'')]
*[[Korean conflict]]
**[[South Korea]] raises its terrorism alert level to the second-highest level, citing strong chances of an attack from [[North Korea]] on its overseas [[Diplomatic mission|diplomatic offices]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-raises-diplomatic-alert-levels-citing-north-korea-threats-2024-05-02/ (Reuters)] [https://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20240502050834 (''The Korea Herald'')]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**[[2024 pro-Palestinian protests on university campuses]] 
***[[2024 University of California, Los Angeles pro-Palestinian campus occupation]]
****Police storm the pro-Palestinian encampment at the [[University of California, Los Angeles]], arresting protesters and dismantling the encampment. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/california-police-flatten-pro-palestinian-camp-ucla-arrest-protesters-2024-05-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023–2024 Georgian protests]]
**Protests occur in [[Batumi]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]], against a law requiring foreign [[non-governmental organizations]] to register as [[foreign agent]]s. [https://oc-media.org/georgias-foreign-agent-law-live-protests-against-foreign-agent-law-continue/ (OC Media)]
*[[2024 Solomon Islands general election]]
**[[Jeremiah Manele]] is elected [[Prime Minister of Solomon Islands]]. [https://apnews.com/article/solomon-islands-prime-minister-jeremiah-manale-fcf911d376d56f9ee8d235fb885c9bc6 (AP)]
*[[2024 United Kingdom local elections]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] holds [[local elections]], as well as a [[2024 Blackpool South by-election|parliamentary by-election]] in the [[Blackpool South (UK Parliament constituency)|Blackpool South constituency]]. The [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] wins most councils. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-politics-68609729 (BBC News)]
